source: Ochre seed heads surrounded by golden ray florets.

source: Rose and cream bells climb each side of the slender stems.
en: Rose and cream bells climb each side of the slender stems.
de: Rosafarbene und cremeweiße Glocken reihen sich an den schlanken Stängeln.

de: Überlappender blauer Dachschiefer von den Höfen der Ebenen.

source: Dried golden stalks cinched tight with two rope bands.
en: Dried golden stalks cinched tight with two rope bands.
de: Goldgelbes Heu, von zwei Seilen fest zusammengehalten.

source: Pale weathered limestone from ledges above the river.
en: Pale weathered limestone from ledges above the river.
de: Heller, verwitterter Kalkstein von den Felsbänken über dem Fluss.
